title: PayPal Unified Payments Google Pay Token Credential
description: Google Pay ECv2 token forwarded unchanged for the google_pay instrument. The merchant base64-encodes it and captures via PayPal Orders v2 as payment_source.google_pay.token.

token.description: Raw Google Pay ECv2 token (a JSON string) from paymentMethodData.tokenizationData.token, forwarded unchanged.
